B15.boundary_and_ownership: C# application/Handler/DI/static serializer surface; B17 owns actual native host.
native_reuse: Required Rust Server B17 provides all transport/protocol/runtime resources.
C# .NET static JSON metadata and existing Core binding generator provide the application surface.
csharp_surface: NativeServerBuilder, NativeServer, typed route descriptors, WeaveRequest/Response, generated JsonTypeInfo registrations.
Application-to-native registration contains Handler IDs and immutable metadata; no per-route Cargo or Rust code generation.
One reusable registered native dispatch callback enqueues bounded managed work; business delegates never run synchronously under native locks.
implementation_steps: Implement immutable validated builder/route/serializer configuration with duplicate/unsupported feature diagnostics.
Use the accepted Server operation table and Core loader to bind the native module; write no managed HTTP parser/listener.
Create one application/DI request scope after successful admission; invoke typed Handler on managed scheduler and complete native operation exactly once.
Provide owned async body APIs by consuming B16; release DTO/input/result owners on mapping failure and cancellation.
Implement ordinary local consumption and Native AOT package tests after B17 is available.

Native callback delivers only a request/operation ticket. Managed scheduled work performs typed take_request outside the callback, then creates the application request scope; do not transfer request owners through the callback itself.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Handler exception maps to bounded HTTP error only before headers commit; after commit close/reset with diagnostic.

native_reuse: http-body/Bytes/Tokio bounded channels and owner-backed buffers; no managed protocol AST/runtime.

implementation_steps: Implement checked global/per-request byte coordinator with atomic grants or rollback-safe try-acquire; reject impossible single-object credit requests.
Acquire credit before allocation/pin/copy; transfer charge with owner and retain full backing allocation charge through clones/nonempty slices.
Reserve bounded copy overlap slack on both sides; cancellation removes metadata waiters and returns uncommitted reservations.
Implement native Body bridge and C# safe lease facade over existing Core buffer/async; optional pipes facade cannot alter ownership.
Test the streaming crate/facade independently on real native Body/protocol fixtures; end-to-end assembled application/soak belongs to B22/B23.

B18.title: Native Tonic gRPC and C# Static Protobuf Mapping
B18.boundary_and_ownership: Rust Tonic gRPC protocol with statically generated C# DTO codec/dispatch; optional package for consumers.
native_reuse: Tonic0.14.9 public Codec/Encoder/Decoder, Grpc and Unary/ServerStreaming/ClientStreaming/StreamingService traits.
Reuse B17 HTTP2/TLS/runtime and B16 owned chunks; do not add grpc-dotnet Server transport.
csharp_surface: Runtime /package.Service/Method descriptor with kind/Handler ID/caps/auth/deadline plus generated typed C# encode/decode delegates.
Native RawCodec carries complete Bytes messages; tonic::Request<Bytes> or Streaming<Bytes>; tonic::Response<Bytes> or bounded Stream<Result<Bytes,Status>>.
Only host_task_id B17 in C-PROTOCOL profile; HTTP2 and protocol features negotiated explicitly.
implementation_steps: Implement one runtime method router and four public native service adapters; copy/release payload ownership through Core operations.
Use generated C# protobuf models/typed parsers; no runtime schema compiler or reflection-discovered services.
Keep Tonic framing/compression/trailers/statuses native; preserve framed length OutOfRange11 versus decompression ResourceExhausted8.
Implement strict small Rust deadline policy: one1–8-digit timeout+H/M/S/m/u/n, checked/capped monotonic budget starting at admission; invalid3/expired4 statuses.
Keep deadline and body/operation owner alive after response head; private Tonic GrpcTimeout is not callable and only wraps ResponseFuture.
Integrate all method kinds and conformance clients under Windows/Linux Native AOT.

Construct a fresh Decoder for each request and selected method kind. Unary/server-stream methods accept exactly one frame, including a zero-byte protobuf message; reject a second frame with InvalidArgument(3) before Handler invocation. Client/bidi streaming permits multiple frames within total quota.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Unknown method, empty/multiple unary messages, truncated/oversize/compression payload, DTO failure, duplicate/invalid timeout and metadata errors preserve protocol categories.
After trailers/headers commit do not send a second HTTP JSON response; cancel does not prove remote side-effect rollback.
C# serialization temporary memory and native retained message buffers are independently charged.

B19.boundary_and_ownership: Rust rmcp protocol with runtime tool metadata and static C# handlers/JSON metadata; optional package for consumers.
native_reuse: rmcp3.10.0 StreamableHttpService<ForeignMcp,LocalSessionManager> Tower service and native model/transport.
csharp_surface: Native runtime tool/resource/prompt descriptors, one ForeignMcp ServerHandler; get_info/supported_protocol_versions/list_tools/get_tool/call_tool.
C# MapMcp(GeneratedTools.All,profile,JsonContext), typed application delegates and explicit auth checks.
implementation_steps: Enable exact2026-07-28 no-legacy/no-event-store profile, JSON response, required protocol metadata, finite body/schema/string/depth limits.
Supply explicit Host/Origin allowlists with ports; Origin is not authentication and absence does not bypass auth.
Register runtime tools and exact get_tool schemas; schema-dependent SEP-2243 Mcp-Param-* checks do not equal general JSON Schema argument validation.
Map native-decoded arguments through bounded owned UTF8 buffers into typed static C# DTOs and back; charge double parse/encode temporaries and measure cost.
Keep native protocol/JSON-RPC/MCP errors distinct from tool execution error results and HTTP pre-parser failures.
No-event-store unfinished response disconnect cancels; persisted/replay/legacy profiles remain explicitly unsupported until separately specified and accepted.

Before public rmcp StreamableHttpService parses a body, apply D19/D07 native Tower preflight with budgeted wire buffer and serde Deserializer/DeserializeSeed/Visitor structural scan; reserve the source-justified worst live native/managed peak including SDK recollection/tree and DTO copies. No private expect_json call or handwritten parser; unproved profile bounds cannot be enabled.

Tool annotations are not authorization; expensive metadata generation happens before serving.
Arbitrary JSON Schema validator is an explicit future capability choice, not falsely supplied by get_tool; current typed DTO validation is required glue.

Coordinate single monotonic request deadline and bounded close; expose ClosePending and continue retirement safely rather than free on timeout.
